independentReconstruction: Executed experiment in memory only: disabled snap writes and removed final report write. All six reconstructed NAa outlines equal saved stages. Final stage3 outlines equal actual current root WOFF2 exactly.
causalAssessment: Supported for these three current glyphs: original and after-a N/A clean; each gains two pinhole/seam artifacts immediately after rawpoint lam_dam, before bien_doi. Offset-disabled ablation retains identical transform/spacing but not those artifacts. a after-a already has a notch at join; lam_dam enlarges it into triangular seam. Thus do not claim every imperfection of a originated in lam_dam.
mechanism: lam_dam iterates raw glyf coordinates without distinguishing on/off-curve points and applies polygon neighbor-normal shift; this is not an offset of quadratic curve geometry. In-memory pipeline confirms source+a-rebuild→offset→transform order.
candidateAssessment: Curve-aware stroke2net round cap/join plus union, conic/quadratic conversion, no area-threshold filtering. Viewed actual stage5 looks clean for N/A/a at reported200CSSpx; current/trial advances+LSB and bbox equal for all3. Metrics were copied from current deliberately, not independent evidence of whole-font metric preservation.
limits: Only NAa Dam subset, not complete DDH font or De style.
No independent full-font/compound/diacritic/anchor/kerning validation or normal app-size grayscale/subpixel raster review.
JPEG evidence does not establish absence of smaller artifacts at every size; no claim of universal typographic equivalence.
No production font modification or approval.
ketQua: Đạt đối với lập luận causal giới hạn3glyph; không duyệt candidate làm font toàn bộ.
